title: Just started an AI trading bot

replies.body: I personally dont think it is but a lot of things these days are often sketchy it can be hard to tell what is good and whats not its a risk we all take.

replies.author: Pretty_Gate34
replies.body: My biggest tip is regardless of any strategy you choose for it, the main important part is the system you built to support that strategy. Strict Entry and exit will almost always be the main factor more so important than the strategy. Keep it deterministic, so it’s routed strictly in math and automate backtesting and live forward, some folks do a loop learning experience so it teaches itself faster on what works and what doesn’t work.
